authorization: Root authorizes exact byte-identical coalescing of these nine already-closed Phase22 frontend, history and checkup roots only; preserve every logical file, byte and mode. v2 uses a per-replacement append journal to avoid repeatedly serializing all previous groups. Independent review required before launch.
identityContract: Captured bytes, paths and modes are binding. Inode/link-count/ctime/mtime are not bound by workflow or capsule identity. All selected experiment files remain immutable; new candidates copy into fresh paths.
capture: Collector manually creates regular TarInfo records and writes all logical payloads. No archive hardlink or external target is introduced.
